description.en: Specifies whether to allow full table scan.
The name of the database to which the table belongs.
The ID of the DRDS instance.
The names of the associated tables.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds setup-table --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --db-name test --allow-full-table-scan true --table-name example-string --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds SetupTable --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --TableName.1 'example-string' --DbName test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AllowFullTableScan true
